current_reader_identity: Pinned preparation/feature/record/raw-validator code is separate from immutable historical v3 producer runtime/harness metadata; no equality assumption for unrelated current Engine/profile/replay files.
excluded: All v1/v2 recovery failures, new scenes, changed source bytes, held-out data and all expert-substituted targets.

held_out.development_gate: Retain the existing fixed24-owner dev gate and >=2/4 goals per original seed; separate reviewed evaluation required before any held-out unlock; no learned result in this source-only slice.

ordering: Baseline training seeds 1000..1007 then recovery 2100,2101; dev 1008..1011 unchanged; episode 0/increasing tick; identical across all six models.
right_censoring: Recovery sources are separate fresh sequences ending paused at coverage_complete, not natural task terminals. Zero hidden at each source start, carry and detach at 32/32/3 boundaries, include all three final rows, then discard final hidden. No padding, terminal bootstrap, cross-source carry or continuation claim.
scope: Executed-action imitation on the fixed v2 baseline plus two observed right-censored first-cycle development records; preparation only in this slice. No causal coverage benefit, task success, biological, physical or production qualification.
stop_policy: Any identity/admission/finite/deadline/storage failure stops preparation without publishing an admissible data manifest. Preserve pending/failure evidence; no retry or fallback.
targets: Every recorded actual float32 action, including all 21 prefix actions per recovery source; expert_action is audit metadata only. No replacement, cropping, weighting, balancing or duplicate rows.

training.rewiring: existing degree-preserving swaps, count and weight multiset; declared seed only, no reachability screening/retries
training.selection: minimum recorded-dev loss over exactly 20 epochs; first epoch wins exact ties; no winning seed or held-out selection
training.training_graph: unchanged pinned 138-node 1647-edge extraction; W[post,pre]; original incoming-strength scalar shared with matched control
